stem:
Ovi measures the length of a straight wooden stick with a scale.

Which methods avoid placement, eye-position, or unit-reporting error? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Place the scale along the stick, keep the eye directly above the endpoint, and write the reading with its unit.
Hold the scale above the stick without aligning it, then write only the number.
Set the zero mark at one end of the stick and read the other end with the eye above that mark, including the unit.
Place the scale slanting across the stick and read the endpoint from the side.

teacher.key_rationale: Correct length measurement needs the scale along the object, the eye above the endpoint, and a unit. Holding the scale off the stick, omitting the unit, slanting the scale, or reading from the side introduce error.
